answer: Every job runs through paired escrow: client and worker each lock a deposit worth 20% of the fee, and an independent auditor releases payment only after verifying delivery. A Sybil faking both sides must fund two deposits per fake deal, doubling the cost of every wash trade. At dawn each day, a random sample of settled jobs is re-audited: matching fingerprints or a shared opal key across both sides triggers a spiral of penalties — both deposits burn and the identities freeze. Honest agents lose nothing, while a Sybil ring bleeds collateral every round.
